execution_gate: Run only if live_insurgency_closure_recertification_results_v1.json passes its preregistered gate.
purpose: Re-run the fixed domestic-government strategy menu on a prospectively selected persistent live-insurgency regime after correcting canonical fielded-force semantics.

challenge_support.selection_note: 0.0625 is selected because it passed the preregistered day-360 viability gate and its median runway ratio (0.393747) was closest to 0.50 among eligible candidate rates. This choice was made without policy outcomes.
challenge_support.interpretation: This is an environmental challenge regime, not a government strategy lever or an empirically calibrated recruitment rate.

baseline_only_preflight.rationale: The mobilization confirmation isolated metabolism with government underground disruption disabled, whereas the policy environment retains default disruption. A baseline-only persistence check is therefore required before policy contrasts so the frontier is not estimated against a floor-collapsed insurgency.

design.failure_rule: If the untouched baseline-only seed block misses any persistence minimum, do not run or interpret the policy menu on that challenge regime. Expand challenge support under a new preregistered baseline-only contract without inspecting policy contrasts.

measurement_corrections.canonical_fielded_force: Zero whenever the canonical insurgent organization is inactive; otherwise sum only active, operational, in-country canonical insurgent formations.
measurement_corrections.ecosystem_reporting: Report rooted membership, operational force, recruitment hazard, and active organization count over all active insurgent-kind organizations in parallel with canonical outcomes.
measurement_corrections.cost: Gross negative changes in government organizational capital during the intervention, categorized by event family; positive inflows reported separately.

primary_analysis: Use within-seed contrasts against baseline at day 240 and day 360.
Do not combine distinct outcomes into a single utility score.

For each insurgent regenerative outcome report absolute effect, percent effect where denominator is stable, durability from intervention end to final, and effect per incremental government capital outflow.

Identify Pareto-dominated packages using durable insurgent suppression, government control, legitimacy, local institution capacity, government losses, civilian population loss/displacement, and gross government outflow.

Report canonical and whole-ecosystem insurgent outcomes side by side; a package cannot be called suppressive if the canonical organization shrinks while the active insurgent ecosystem substitutes enough to erase the effect.
Report seed-level collapse fractions and timepoint live fractions separately from continuous means.
selection_guard: No strategy may be added, removed, or have coefficients changed after fresh live-support policy outcomes are inspected. Continuous optimization or new force-composition/air-support packages require a new contract and untouched seed block.
interpretation_guard: Synthetic Pineland mechanism comparison only. Passing closure and this policy assay does not constitute historical validation or a real-world operational prescription.
